title: Daniel — Instructions and Commands
content:
Daniel — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

36 additional passage records · 76 quoted verse units. Read Daniel in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Source coverage includes Susanna and Bel and the Dragon. Their references use their named reading pages, so Susanna 1:53 is not confused with Daniel 1 or Bel and the Dragon 1.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Mercy, neighbors and the vulnerable · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Daniel 6:8 – Daniel 6:9

Record type: Reported hostile or rejected order. Source section: The Plot Against Daniel.

Daniel 6:8 — “We have established a restriction and decree: anyone who offers a prayer or makes any request to any god for thirty days, except to King Darius, will be thrown into the lions’ pit.”

Daniel 6:9 — They asked the king to establish the restriction and not alter it, because they knew that Daniel prayed and entreated three times a day; they intended him to be brought down through the king and thrown into the lions’ pit.

Context and scope: This order is recorded as hostile, coercive or contrary to faithful obedience in its narrative context. It is not included as a divine command to obey.
